question.text: The commodity exchanges in India where futures and options are currently traded include:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists the current Indian exchanges where commodity derivatives are traded as MCX, NCDEX, NSE and BSE. LME is a London-based international exchange and is therefore not part of the Indian list. The Trap: The list is not limited to only MCX/NCDEX or only NSE/BSE, and LME does not belong with Indian exchanges. Note: The explanation relies only on the source-supported exchange list; no claim about exchange-wise dominance or best execution is made here.
